observations: Original 'fat' model PlayStation 4 console in black.
One black DualShock 4 controller is visible in front of the console.
The console has a two-tone finish (matte and glossy).
The 'PS4' logo is visible on the side/top panel in photo 0.
The 'SONY' logo is visible on the glossy front section in photo 0.
Image contains watermarks for 'HYMAN GADGETS HUB' and 'Jiji'.

claims.evidence: External condition looks acceptable in one photo, but internal condition and origin cannot be verified remotely.
Only one controller (pad) is visible in photo 0.
No physical game discs are shown, and no screenshots of a digital library are provided.

risks.risk: The console may have hardware issues such as overheating, a faulty disc drive, or the 'Blue Light of Death'.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and successfully loading a game disc.

risks.risk: The games may be digital licenses tied to an account that the buyer cannot keep, or they may not exist.
risks.proof: Photos of 10 physical game discs or a video showing the games being played on a guest account.

risks.risk: The second controller may be missing or a non-functional third-party clone.
risks.proof: A photo of both controllers together and a video of them being used to navigate the menu.

risks.risk: The storage capacity is unknown and could be the minimum 500GB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage Management' screen in settings.

proof_requests: Photos of the 10 game discs, especially FC24.
Video of the console turned on, showing the 'System Information' (storage size) and launching a game.
Photo of the back of the console to check for intact warranty seals.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an original PlayStation 4. It can be priced at its worst-case value (500GB, one controller, no games) until the seller provides proof of the additional items and functionality.
